Bachelor's, Master's and Doctoral degree holders
Fully funded scholarship with variable awards
Global Korea Scholarship Program 2022 is an opportunity offered to bachelor's, master's and doctoral degree holders.
This scholarship aims to provide financial assistance

to international students who want to pursue higher studies in undergraduate and graduate programmes at the institutions of the Republic of Korea. The selected candidates will receive variable awards.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Be below 25 years at the date of joining
Be under 40 years of age at the date of joining
Have secured 80% or more marks from the last attended educational institution [CGPA: 2.64/4.0 or 2.80/4.3 or 2.91/4.5, or 3.23/5.0]
Be in good physical and mental health
Have a minimum of 16 and 18 years of formal education to apply for PG and PhD courses
The selected fellow will receive the following benefits -
Living Allowance of 900,000 KRW to 1,000,000 KRW
Language Courses costing KRW 800,000 per quarter
Medical Insurance of KRW 20,000 per month
Class 10 and 12’s mark sheets and certificates
Applicant's parent's proof of citizenship document
Proof of Korean war veteran's descendants (only for Korean war veteran's descendants)
Proof of overseas Korean document (only for overseas Korean)
The eligible candidates can apply for the post by using the below-mentioned steps -
Submit all documents related to the scholarship application to the Korean Embassy in the country of residence or the domestic university concerned.
The candidates will be selected based on the eligibility criteria.
NIIED evaluates potential candidates and notifies the Korean Embassy of the final selected KGSP grantees.
NIIED invites the Korean Embassy in the invited country or a domestic university to recommend potential candidates.
Ministry of Education, Government of Korea
